0022600225.text: The Rockets (8-3, 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West) host the Warriors (7-3, 2nd in the Pacific and 7th in the West) in Houston's 12th game of the season, with Houston riding a W1 streak and Golden State on a W7 streak. Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), and Oscar Tshiebwe is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision, while Golden State is without Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Will Richard (thumb). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, but the Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-116 win in San Francisco on April 5, 2026.
